QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Another Beginning for the Maple Alliance
QuestInfo.0:
Penni asks if you know #bAthena Pierce#k, in Henesys Bowman Instructional School.
He says she helped him before, and he'd like to go thank her. Maybe you should tag along.
QuestInfo.1:
You met Athena Pierce, who told you a bit the #bMaple Alliance#k.
You're invited to join, by meeting with the Empress in Ereve.
QuestInfo.2:
Last time Athena Pierce saw Penni, she treated Penni's wing, after one of her students accidentally shot him. 
Penni wanted to say thanks, and invited you along to Henesys Bowman Instructional School.

There, Athena Pierce told you about the #bMaple Alliance#k.
If you want to join, head for Ereve.
